source.transcript: Do you miss someone? Yes. Why don't you talk to them? Money don't talk.

transferable_animation_grammar.scene_density: sparse props with generous negative space
transferable_animation_grammar.staging: one dominant action/reaction focus per beat
transferable_animation_grammar.pacing: compact beat changes every few seconds
transferable_animation_grammar.readability: large high-contrast text kept outside character action zones
transferable_animation_grammar.comedy: literal visual reaction supports concise verbal punchline
transferable_animation_grammar.motion: pose/reaction changes carry meaning; avoid lecture-slide pacing

adaptation_rules.preserve_only: timing, framing grammar, line-art simplicity, beat density, reaction cadence
